subject: Provisional version hold for Eos-13B-v2 + integration checklist
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Sara Gomez <sara@apexai.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisional hold request: Eos-13B-v2 (new variant)

Team —

Quick context: QA perf runs against Eos-13B-v2 show a 12–18% tail-latency regression at p99 for long-context (>1024) workloads compared to our pinned Eos-13B-v1 baseline. At the same time, TerraCloud (procurement cc'd) is evaluating the model for a pilot and has asked for a stability commitment before they finalize a reserved capacity deal.

I propose we place a provisional version hold (temporary pin) on Eos-13B-v2 in the hosted catalog and block auto-rollout to Dedicated until we validate compatibility and complete a canary window. Specific asks:
- Action: Place a 30-day provisional hold on Eos-13B-v2 across managed routes (hosted + dedicated intake)
- Tech: Run compatibility checks for quantized variants and memory footprint (Karthik)
- Canary: Schedule a 72-hour canary with traffic shaping and p99 telemetry (Ops)
- Customer comms: Provide TerraCloud a short note on mitigation and ETA (Monica)

Attached is the perf extract for the failing runs (eos13b_perf_report.pdf). I want to make a safe call quickly to avoid customer churn but also avoid unnecessary blocking if fixes are straightforward.

Laura
Product Manager — Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: eos13b_perf_report.pdf (summary of p50/p95/p99 runs, seeds, config)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional hold request: Eos-13B-v2 (new variant)

Thanks for the heads up — good catch. A few quick clarifying questions before I can sign off on a hold and run the checks: 
1) Which variants were included in the perf runs (fp16, int8-quant, awq)? Please list exact artifact tags.
2) Was the regression reproducible on the latest runtime build (r2027-04-28)? We saw a KV cache path fix in r2027-04-28 that affects long-context p99s.
3) Canary plan: do we have a canary cluster and traffic profile? If not, I can allocate a small canary pool but need approval for cost.

I started a quick compatibility smoke (artifact tags needed) and will drop the csv here (compat-check-output.csv) when done. If the regression is only observable on fp16 non-quantized builds, the mitigation may be a config toggle (memory alignment + shorter scheduling window) not a full pin.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer — Serving Runtime

Laura/Karthik —

I support a short provisional hold given the customer pressure, but I'd like to reduce the window to 21 calendar days unless we escalate. Two requests before I formally approve: 
- Karthik: provide a short cost estimate for the canary (cpu/gpu hours) and the rollback complexity (how quick to restore v1 routing) — 1 paragraph ok.
- Laura/Monica: draft the customer-facing note that confirms a stability review and an expected ETA for the final decision (aim for 5 business days).

Action owners:
- Provisional hold & catalog flag (Ops): Rohan (I will coordinate with infra ops after Karthik's estimate)
- Canary run & telemetry baseline: Karthik
- Customer comms & procurement alignment: Monica

If we get the two items above by EOD tomorrow, I approve the 21-day provisional hold.

Rohan Mehta
Head of Product Operations

Subject: Re: Provisional hold request: Eos-13B-v2 (new variant)

Confirming TerraCloud is asking for a short written commitment on model stability before they sign the reserved capacity term sheet. They do not need a public statement, just an embargoed note and a timeline.

I drafted the customer note below (short):
"TerraCloud — we are pausing automatic rollout of Eos-13B-v2 for 21 days while we complete a focused stability and compatibility review. During this period we will run a controlled canary, share telemetry summaries, and provide a mitigation/rollback plan. We expect to confirm findings within 5 business days."

If Rohan approves the 21-day hold, I will send this note to TerraCloud under NDA and attach the risk matrix (terra_risk_matrix.xlsx).

Monica
Customer Success Manager
